landing.tagline: A calendar-first productivity app built for neurodivergent minds — ADHD, autism, dyslexia, and everyone who thinks differently.
landing.problem: Traditional planners assume you think linearly. They expect you to remember deadlines, estimate time accurately, and stay motivated without external structure. For neurodivergent brains, this isn't a skill issue — it's a mismatch between the tool and the mind.
landing.solution: NeuroBoost puts the calendar at the center of everything. Tasks aren't just a list — they're scheduled blocks of time. The calendar is truth. Everything else exists to support it.

calendar.title: Visual Calendar
calendar.desc: A week-first view with drag-and-drop scheduling. See your entire week at a glance, not just a list of obligations.

tasks.title: Smart Tasks
tasks.desc: Priority-grouped tasks with energy levels and GTD contexts. Drag any task onto the calendar to schedule it instantly.

planning.title: Weekly Planning
planning.desc: Structured planning sessions to review the past week and prepare the next — without the overwhelm of a blank page.

reflections.title: Reflections
reflections.desc: Quick post-event check-ins to track focus, energy, and mood over time. Learn what conditions help you thrive.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro Timer
pomodoro.desc: Built-in focus timer integrated with your calendar. Work in sustainable intervals and take breaks your brain actually needs.

timeBlocking.title: Time Blocking
timeBlocking.desc: Convert intention into commitment by placing tasks on the calendar. If it's not scheduled, it's not real.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready for a planner that works with your brain?
landing.ctaText: Join NeuroBoost and start scheduling the way your brain actually works.
landing.footer: © {{year}} NeuroBoost. Built for brains that work differently.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noEventsHint: Click a time slot on the calendar, or schedule a task to fill your day.
